messages:
maria: Planning a regional routing policy update for eu-west -> apac-edge traffic tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Need a deploy owner and a short smoke checklist. TTL will go to 60s for the window.

aj: I can own the deploy. Will be on-call that window. Plan to ramp with weighted DNS: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~10m steps, hold 5m between steps.

sam: Thanks AJ. Quick Q — are we doing a config change in the control-plane or a DNS-only weight swap?

maria: DNS-weighted swap via Route53. Control-plane config already has the apac model variant ready; this is just traffic steering.

dina: I'll prepare the smoke checks and dashboards. Suggest smoke list: 1) token-level latency check on sample prompts, 2) 95p latency on generation under 1.2s, 3) error rate < 0.1% for 5m window, 4) kv-cache warm hit for pinned sessions.

leo: Can we include a quick end-to-end sample that verifies KV cache warmup? I can push a small script to run 20 sample chat calls as part of smoke: `scripts/smoke/kv_warmup.sh`

maria: good call. Also need rollback readiness: AJ, who will trigger rollback? And what's the rollback procedure?

aj: I'll trigger rollback. Procedure: 1) weight back to 0% for apac in Route53 console / infra pipeline, 2) set TTL back to 300s after rollback, 3) file a postmortem on the thread if we roll. Have rollback playbook open: https://confluence/redwood/deploy-playbooks/route-weight-rollback

sam: Preflight checklist I ran earlier: health probes green in apac region, model variant healthy on 3 nodes, warm caches present. I also validated signed certs for apac edge.

dina: Smoke script snippets (to paste in runbook):
```bash
# run from ci-runner with credentials
curl -X POST $REDWOOD_API/chat -d '{"model":"redwood-2.1","input":"hello"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
Outputs should be 200 and contain `{"choices"` and latency header `x-req-latency-ms`.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment window created for 2026-03-20T09:30:00Z by aj. Runbook: /runbooks/eng/eu-apac-routing-window. Incident channel: #incidents if rollback escalates.

maria: On the actual swap timeline: we'll set TTL->60 at T-10m, start weights at T+0 (09:30). Ramp: 10% @09:30, 50% @09:40, 100% @09:50. Hold 5m between steps for metrics.

aj: I'll post live updates in this thread during the ramp. If any step breaches thresholds (latency or error), I'll cut to rollback immediately.

leo: I'll monitor logs+traces (tracing dashboard link: https://grafana/redwood/traces?org=eng). I'll also run the KV warmup script at T-05m.

sam: Ping me if we need quick model variant fallback; I can flip the control-plane route to the older variant if DNS weight rollback doesn't stabilize in 3m.

maria: Perfect. Final confirmations: AJ (deploy owner) ✅, Dina (smoke + runbook) ✅, Leo (observability) ✅, Sam (variant fallback) ✅. Any objections?

aj: No objections. I'll be live. Please avoid other infra changes in the 09:00-10:30 UTC window.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. Posting the final runbook link: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/eu-apac-weighted-rollout. See you in the thread during the window :thumbsup:
